The condition invokes adjudication rather than approving a credit, goodwill concession, or the dispute's validity. This is a reference-model proposal under research-industry.md §Commercial and marketing; research-mpc.md §4 supports context only.

raw_target: Manage Commercial Terms, Quoting, and Customer Commercial Services (CM-1-3-7-2)
condition: a qualified sales outcome is handed to the target for controlled quote or commercial-terms processing
scope_note_sentence: When a qualified sales outcome is handed to the target for controlled quote or commercial-terms processing, Sales Execution (CM-1-3-6-2) supplies qualified commercial quote packages and approved customer-arrangement requests that Manage Commercial Terms, Quoting, and Customer Commercial Services (CM-1-3-7-2) consumes in its defined work.
reason: The source expressly hands qualified outcomes to controlled quote/contract processes, and the target lifecycle-manages what Develop Quote composes. This is the capability-level commercial-pursuit handoff, not a transfer of pricing, credit, legal, or order authority. This is a reference-model proposal under research-industry.md §Commercial and marketing; research-mpc.md §4 supports context only.
Hamid_decision: APPROVE: approved in the Phase 1 register (Hamid 2026-10-12, #207 comment 6133390674)

condition: the trade is confirmed under a governing agreement administered by the source
scope_note_sentence: When the trade is confirmed under a governing agreement administered by the source, Contract Management (CM-1-2-1-2) supplies current governing master-agreement terms and applicable confirmation provisions that Confirmations Management (CM-1-2-2-2) consumes in its defined work.
reason: The source administers governing agreements while confirmation generation uses their templates and terms. That specific agreement-output dependency survives the exclusion of independent confirmation work, without requiring a bespoke agreement for every spot or exchange transaction. This is a reference-model proposal under research-industry.md §Supply and trading; research-mpc.md §2 supports context only.
